engagement_greeting.purpose: Warmly greet the new visitor. The elevator pitch has already been delivered by Vapi. Identify what brought them here (visitor_context) and where they are in their journey (career_stage).

value_exploration.purpose: Walk the visitor through BoostCTC's methodology and career evolution path to find what resonates — Daily Practice, AI Feedback, Continuous Progress, Socratic Guide. Capture interest_area and resonance_point.

socratic_taste.purpose: Give the visitor a live taste of BoostCTC's Socratic coaching method with a vivid reflective question matched to their interest_area. Capture reflection_response and engagement_signal.

lead_capture.purpose: Capture the interested visitor's name and email so they can get started with BoostCTC.

engagement_wrapup.purpose: Gracefully close the conversation when the visitor is not ready to sign up. No pressure, open door.
